title: HIV and AIDS
summary: HIV is a virus that weakens the immune system; untreated it can lead to AIDS. It spreads through blood, semen, vaginal fluids and breast milk — not through kissing, hugging or sharing food.
key_points: Daily treatment lets people with HIV live long, healthy lives.
Undetectable = untransmittable (U=U): an undetectable viral load means HIV isn't passed through sex.
Condoms, PrEP and PEP prevent transmission.
